description: Defines the AudioResampler interface for converting audio sample and storage types, including creation and resampling methods, within the starboard::shared::starboard::player::filter namespace.

classes.name: AudioResampler
classes.description: Interface for converting input audio samples to different formats and storage types, with methods for resampling, signaling end of stream, and creation.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals that the last input frame has been written, allowing internal cache to be read out.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an AudioResampler with specified input/output formats and sample rates.
